highlights: PopQueryPowerSettingUlong acquires PopSettingLock, calls PopFindPowerSettingConfiguration, reads DWORD payloads from configuration slots, and releases the fast mutex with no visible registry API in the retained disassembly.

PopGetPowerSettingValue likewise acquires PopSettingLock, resolves a configuration entry through PopFindPowerSettingConfiguration, copies the value blob with memcpy, and releases the lock without a visible registry call in the retained path.

The visible PopSetPowerSettingValue path allocates PSeT-tagged buffers, validates input, updates in-memory setting blobs, increments PopPowerSettingChangeStamp, walks PopRegisteredPowerSettingCallbacks, and schedules PopSetNotificationWork. The retained path did not expose a visible registry API.
